original_query: select min(c_customer_sk), min(ss_item_sk), min(sr_ticket_number), min(ws_order_number) FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90' day) AND ca_state in ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK') AND d1.d_year = 2000 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '0-500' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01 ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT MIN(c.c_customer_sk) AS min_customer_sk,
       MIN(ss.ss_item_sk) AS min_item_sk,
       MIN(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS min_ticket_number,
       MIN(ws.ws_order_number) AS min_order_number
FROM date_dim AS d1
JOIN store_returns AS sr
  ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN item AS i
  ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND i.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports')
JOIN store_sales AS ss
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN customer AS c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address AS ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
 AND ca.ca_state IN ('IA', 'KS', 'MD', 'MO', 'OK')
JOIN household_demographics AS hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
 AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
 AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '0-500'
JOIN web_sales AS ws
  ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
 AND ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
 AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90 day'
WHERE d1.d_year = 2000
  AND ss.ss_sales_price >= (38 * 0.01) * ss.ss_list_price
  AND ss.ss_sales_price <= (58 * 0.01) * ss.ss_list_price;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Rewrite ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 38*0.01 AND 58*0.01 as cross-multiplication (ss_sales_price >= 0.38*ss_list_price AND ss_sales_price <= 0.58*ss_list_price), avoiding per-row division. Equivalent for positive list_price (TPC-DS guarantee).

Convert implicit comma joins to explicit ANSI JOINs with dimension filters (item category, address state, household demographics) pushed into the JOIN ON clauses for clarity and easier predicate placement.
No CTEs introduced: there are no repeated subquery computations, and the planner already pushes d1.d_year = 2000 and other dimension filters effectively; CTEs would add no benefit here.
Keep the d2 date-range condition (within 90 days of d1.d_date) in the JOIN ON clause; the date_dim d1 filter on d_year = 2000 stays in WHERE to reduce store_returns rows early.
